neighbours.label: The token just before 'weeks' or a period word in a duration ('4 to 6 weeks', 'a few weeks', 'monthly or quarterly'); the same number frames with objects stay under it
fire: Delivery usually takes 4 to 6 weeks from the order.
The rash goes away in a few weeks without treatment.
Puppies need shots at 8 to 12 weeks of age.
Invoices are sent out on a weekly or monthly basis.
Seedlings are ready in 6 to 8 weeks.
You will feel better in a few weeks.
Interest is paid on a quarterly or yearly basis.
The course lasts 10 to 12 weeks in spring.
quiet: Delivery usually takes a van from the depot to the door.
The rash goes away with a few drops of oil.
Puppies need shots from a vet in the town.
Invoices are sent out on a blue or white sheet.
Seedlings are sold in 6 to 8 packs.
You will feel better in a warm bed.

notes: Card: ' six' x4, ' to' x3, '-' x3, ' ' x3, '6' x2, ' few' x2, ' or' after monthly. The + pole's logit effect promotes ' month', ' months', ' monthly', so the - pole suppresses those and fires before weeks and quarters. Probe: '12 to 16' 1.22, 'monthly or' 0.75, 'a few' 0.73, '4 to 6' 0.67; '12 to 16 eggs' 0.01, 'a few drops' 0.12, but '4 to 6 colours' 0.47.
